description: M2 catalog of every pack variant under astrid/packs/. Classifies packs by the capability types they ship (executors, orchestrators, elements). Aligns with INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS constant in astrid/structure.py. Updated post M2 Top-Level Module Rationalization to reflect current pack taxonomy, documented shell exceptions, and stable pack/capability IDs.

variant_classifications.manifest_only: Has pack.yaml but no executors/, orchestrators/, or elements/ directories with capability subdirectories.
variant_classifications.mixed_executor_orchestrator: Ships both executor and orchestrator capabilities.
variant_classifications.mixed_executor_element: Ships both executor and element capabilities.
variant_classifications.mixed_full: Ships executor, orchestrator, and element capabilities.
variant_classifications.internal: Infrastructure directory under packs/, not a shipped pack (no pack.yaml).

__pycache__.notes: CPython bytecode cache — removed from pack tree in M1 (T11); gitignore prevents regeneration.

_core.notes: Visible skill-only shell (M2 classified). Contains skill/SKILL.md only — the root Astrid gateway skill. No pack.yaml, no capabilities. Coupled to astrid/skills/registry.py, astrid/skills/discovery.py, astrid/skills/harnesses/*, and astrid/skills/__init__.py. INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS excludes it from pack structure validation. M2 treats it as a permanent visible exception — not moved under _shells/.

packs.notes: Hidden compatibility shell (M2 classified). visibility:hidden, status:deprecated. Declares 15+ pack-level aliases mapping legacy builtin.* capability ids to canonical homes. Contains agent_probe.py (dsl_orchestrator_shim used by 16+ regression tests, documented exception), fixtures/, and golden/. Empty executors/ and orchestrators/ directories contain only __init__.py files. Not moved under _shells/ in M2 to preserve stable pack ID and alias contract.
Single-executor pack for ComfyUI wrapping. Stable pack ID: comfy_wrap. Stable capability ID: comfy_wrap.run.
Large executor-only pack with 15 executors. Includes skill/ for agent-facing documentation.
Mixed pack with 2 executors and 1 orchestrator (foley_map). Includes skill/.
Executor pack with 3 generation executors (generate_image, generate_video, generate_audio or similar). Includes skill/ and golden/ test fixtures.
Executor pack with 2 executors (assemble, prepare). __init__.py removed in M1 T14 (not needed for sub-package imports).
Single-executor pack (clip_extract). AGENTS.md migrated to skill/SKILL.md in M1 T3; README.md and STAGE.md removed in M1 T17.
Executor pack with 4 executors for Reigh data platform integration. Includes skill/.
Mixed pack with 3 executors and 4 element kinds (animations, effects, transitions, plus _shared contracts). The only pack currently shipping elements. Includes skill/.
Executor pack with 5 executors for RunPod serverless GPU integration (session, exec, etc.).

Mixed pack with 2 executors (clip_candidates, segment_map) and 1 orchestrator (distill). Has __init__.py (legacy_public_shim preserved for sub-package imports by 6 call sites — classified in M2) and skill/. Stable pack ID: stream_content. Stable capability IDs: stream_content.clip_candidates, stream_content.segment_map, stream_content.distill.

Orchestrator pack with 1 DSL orchestrator (summarize, migrated to orchestrators/summarize/run.py in M1 T13). Contains summarize.py (legacy_public_shim, classified in M2), fixtures/ (including sample.txt), and golden/. Stable pack ID: text_analysis. Stable capability ID: text_analysis.summarize.
Mixed pack with 4 executors and 2 orchestrators for model training workflows.
Executor pack with 5 executors for media understanding (visual, audio, video analysis). Includes skill/.
Executor pack with 2 executors (run, validate) for VibeComfy integration.
Orchestrator-heavy pack with 1 executor and 7 orchestrators for video editing workflows. Includes skill/ and hype.py (legacy_public_shim, M2-deferred).
Executor pack with 2 executors for YouTube integration.

top_level_pack_files.description: Python modules directly under astrid/packs/ (not in pack subdirectories). In M2 these are all compatibility re-export shims whose canonical implementations live in astrid/core/pack/. The astrid/core/pack_machinery/ directory retains thin shims for backward compatibility.

files.name: cli.py
files.notes: Pack CLI compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation moved to astrid/core/pack/cli.py in M2 T7 (was astrid/core/pack_machinery/cli.py in M1 T8).

files.name: install.py
files.notes: Pack installation compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation relocated to astrid/core/pack/install.py in M2 T8. This file is now a thin sys.modules alias shim.

files.name: validate.py
files.notes: Pack validation compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation moved to astrid/core/pack/validate.py in M2 T7 (was astrid/core/pack_machinery/validate.py in M1 T6).

files.name: gitignore.py
files.notes: Gitignore filtering compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation moved to astrid/core/pack/gitignore.py in M2 T7 (was astrid/core/pack_machinery/gitignore.py in M1 T5).

files.name: agent_index.py
files.notes: Agent index compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation moved to astrid/core/pack/agent_index.py in M2 T7 (was astrid/core/pack_machinery/agent_index.py in M1 T7).

files.name: _canonical_entrypoint.py
files.notes: Canonical entrypoint compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation relocated to astrid/core/pack/entrypoint.py in M2 T11. Preserved as a thin public compatibility import path for third-party pack authors.

documented_exceptions.description: Every layout exception that keeps the pack tree from being purely canonical. All are declared in their respective pack.yaml metadata.layout.exceptions and cross-referenced here.

exceptions.reason: DSL @orchestrator definition with 16+ test-file references. Not a canonical executor. Classified in M2 as a documented compatibility shell exception. Migration to orchestrators/agent_probe/ deferred to follow-up milestone.
Legacy author-test DSL shim that duplicates video_editing.hype (canonically at orchestrators/hype/run.py). Classified in M2; kept for backward compatibility.
Compatibility re-export preserving astrid.packs.text_analysis.summarize while the canonical implementation lives at orchestrators/summarize/run.py. Classified in M2.
Preserved helper-package marker required for sub-package imports (6 call sites). Classified in M2.

machinery_shims.reason: Canonical implementation relocated to astrid/core/pack/entrypoint.py in M2 T11. This file is now a thin re-export shim preserving compatibility for 50+ pack run.py import sites. Treated as a documented public compatibility import path for third-party pack authors.

special_directories.reason: Contains only skill/SKILL.md providing the root Astrid skill description. No pack.yaml, executors, or orchestrators.

structure_constants_reference.note: The shared pack manifest schemas moved out of astrid/packs/ in M1 and relocated from astrid/core/pack_machinery/schemas/ to astrid/core/pack/schemas/v1/ in M2 T10. The 'schemas' entry in INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS is a legacy reference to per-pack content roots only.
